title: Quarterly Executive Brief: Impact Snapshot & Renewal Readiness Playbook
content:
Purpose
Provide a compact, sponsor-ready briefing + a customer-facing quarterly recap email template and a lightweight renewal readiness/playbook. This doc is a single-page exec brief for 15-minute sponsor syncs, plus a send-ready customer recap email and a short tracker the CSM can maintain.

Audience
Primary: Executive sponsor at the customer (VP/Head level). Secondary: internal AE/SE and CSM.

TL;DR (1-2 lines)
- Adoption up: {{PCT_USAGE_GROWTH}} QoQ, average latency stable at {{AVG_LAT_MS}}ms.
- Cost-per-token reduced by ~{{PCT_COST_REDUCTION}} via batching + cache.
- Renewal posture: on-track if we close the two outstanding items below; recommended action: 15-min sponsor sync to align on roadmap and SLAs.

IMPACT SNAPSHOT (one-slide / left column)
- Key metrics (current / previous quarter):
  - Monthly active API keys: {{MAK_CURRENT}} ({{MAK_DELTA}})
  - Avg inference latency (P95): {{LAT_P95_CURRENT}}ms ({{LAT_DELTA}})
  - Tokens served / month: {{TOKENS}}
  - Cost per 1k tokens (estimated): ${{COST_1K}} ({{COST_DELTA}})
  - Customer-facing saved costs from caching/quantization: ${{EST_SAVINGS}}
- Business outcomes observed:
  - Time-to-first-response for support flows reduced by {{PCT_REDUCTION_RESPONSE}}
  - Chat conversion uplift for trial users: +{{PCT_CONV}}

ADOPTION & HEALTH HIGHLIGHTS (quick bullets)
- Primary routes in use: /generate, /chat-stream, /embeddings.
- Top 3 models called: rw-large-v1, rw-instruct-1, open-embedding-640.
- Integration notes: Server-side SDK v2.1.3; one customer integration still on v1 (see risk below).
- Observability: trace sampling at 5%; active alerts: 2 non-critical, 1 impending (KV cache saturation).

RISK RADAR (what would keep renewal from being a clean upsell)
- Tech debt: legacy SDK integration (customer internal infra) could cause reduced latency under load — severity medium.
- SLA expectation mismatch: customer expects 99.95% P99 latency; our commitment is 99.9% for shared tier.
- Security/compliance ask: needs SOC2 artifact for on-prem pilot (requested by legal).
- Commercial: renewal target requires maintaining current seat pricing; finance is requesting usage forecast.

RENEWAL READINESS PLAYBOOK (CSM checklist)
- Renewal window: {{RENEWAL_DATE}} (days left: {{DAYS_LEFT}})
- Scorecard (quick):
  - Adoption (30 pts): API routes + seats in active use.
  - Value (30 pts): documented cost savings / conversion impact.
  - Tech posture (20 pts): infra modernity + SRE alerts.
  - Exec alignment (20 pts): sponsor engaged and meeting cadence established.
  - Recommended threshold for confident renewal: >=70/100.
- Immediate actions (owners + ETA):
  - Finalize SOC2 package to legal — Owner: Samir G — ETA: {{ETA_SOC2}}
  - Resolve legacy SDK perf regression — Owner: Jordan K — ETA: {{ETA_SDK_FIX}}
  - Present FY+1 usage forecast and committed capacity options — Owner: AE (Ari P) — ETA: {{ETA_FORECAST}}
- Negotiation play: offer 6% discount for 12-month commit if renewal score between 60-69; otherwise standard renewal path.

EXECUTIVE ASKS (what to ask the sponsor in a 15-min sync)
1) Confirm top 2 business priorities this FY and which LLM use-cases map to them.
2) Approve short list of capacity/commit tiers for budgeting.
3) Confirm legal/compliance point-of-contact and timeline for SOC2 review.
4) Permission to run a 2-week performance test with dedicated caching to validate P99.

PROPOSED 15-MIN SPONSOR AGENDA (timeboxed)
- 0:00 – 0:02: Quick TL;DR (metrics & headline)
- 0:02 – 0:07: Business impact highlights + one customer success story
- 0:07 – 0:11: Risks & asks (the three items above)
- 0:11 – 0:13: Renewal posture & proposed next steps
- 0:13 – 0:15: Decisions and owners

CUSTOMER-FACING QUARTERLY RECAP EMAIL (send-ready, editable)
Subject line options:
- "Q{QUARTER} recap: deployment impact & next steps"
- "{{CUSTOMER_NAME}} — Q{QUARTER} outcomes and renewal planning"

Email body (concise, customer-facing):
Hi {{SPONSOR_NAME}},

Hope you’re well — quick recap of Q{QUARTER} and suggested next steps:

1) What we shipped and the impact:
- Reduced average response latency (P95) to {{LAT_P95_CURRENT}}ms, improving end-user experience on support flows.
- Enabled prefix caching and quantization on 2 high-volume routes, estimated cost savings of ${{EST_SAVINGS}} this quarter.

2) Adoption highlights:
- {{MAK_CURRENT}} active API keys; top features: chat, embeddings.

3) Open items / asks:
- SOC2 evidence: our legal team requested delivery by {{ETA_SOC2}}.
- Legacy SDK update: minor client-side changes planned; target {{ETA_SDK_FIX}}.

4) Ask of you: a 15-min sponsor sync in the next two weeks to confirm roadmap alignment and renewal options.

Suggested times: {{SLOT_1}} / {{SLOT_2}} / {{SLOT_3}}

Thanks,
{{CSM_NAME}} (Redwood Inference)

--
Longer variant (if you want an attached one-pager): include the Impact Snapshot and a sample renewal term sheet (see appendix).

RENEWAL TRACKER (single-line entries that CSM maintains)
- {{CUSTOMER_NAME}} | Renewal: {{RENEWAL_DATE}} | Status: at-risk/in-progress/confirmed | Score: {{SCORE}}/100 | Last touch: {{LAST_TOUCH_DATE}} | Next action: {{NEXT_ACTION}} | Owner: {{CSM_NAME}}

ACTION TRACKER (open items we should surface to sponsor)
- #1 SOC2 package delivery — Owner: Samir G — ETA: {{ETA_SOC2}} — Status: open
- #2 SDK perf regression investigation — Owner: Jordan K — ETA: {{ETA_SDK_FIX}} — Status: in_progress
- #3 Usage forecast for FY+1 — Owner: Ari P — ETA: {{ETA_FORECAST}} — Status: draft

APPENDIX (technical health snapshot for SE/AE)
- Infra: Dedicated cluster usage: {{DEDICATED_PCT}}%
- KV cache hit rate: {{CACHE_HIT}}% (target 85%+).
- Error budget burn (30d): {{ERROR_BUDGET}}%.
- Recent incident summary: one P2 on {{INCIDENT_DATE}} (root cause: autoscaler overshoot), mitigated same day.

NOTES TO CSM (working items / talking points)
- If renewal score in 60-69, prep a pricing incentive (6% off for 12-month) and schedule commercial deep-dive with the AE.
- If sponsor asks for P99 guarantee, propose a dedicated pilot with config + SLA addendum and costs.
- Keep the sponsor engaged via a short monthly status digest (1 slide).

UNRESOLVED QUESTIONS / TODOs
- Confirm whether legal accepts SOC2 documentation via secure S3 or requires a formal audit packet.
- Decide on commit tiers to propose (options: 6m/12m/24m).
- Validate forecast methodology with finance (Ari).

VERSION HISTORY / EDIT LOG
- 2026-01-20: initial draft (Marina L)
- 2026-02-14: added renewal scorecard and sample email variants (Ari P)
- 2026-03-05: updated metrics and action ETA placeholders after SE sync (Jordan K)

Quick checklist before sending to sponsor
- [ ] Metrics verified against analytics dashboard
- [ ] SOC2 ETA confirmed by legal
- [ ] AE notified of pricing proposal
- [ ] Draft email approved by CS lead

End of doc
